entries.title: Point the workflows at the branch this repository actually defaults to
entries.detail:
Adoption wrote `main`, and this repository has no `main` — its remote
HEAD is a branch named after the change that created it. A workflow
written for a branch that does not exist is the silent kind of broken:
it is present, it reads correctly, and it never fires.

Fixed in the adopt command too, which now asks the remote for its HEAD
when the local refs say nothing and neither main nor master was fetched.

entries.title: Adopt backlog/1 and shipped/1
entries.detail:
This repository now publishes the two tenses the estate records: what it
intends, and what it shipped. Both are emitted by a dependency-free
vendored script, so nothing here gains a toolchain it did not have.

Nothing is published by this commit. Backlog items are filed private and
reach the served fragment only when a named human promotes one; shipped
entries land private until someone changes one field in
.shiplog/config.json. The served copy is the public projection and the
emitter writes it, so a private record cannot reach a URL through a
forgotten copy step.

Derived 24 entries from this repository's own history, every seal
recomputed. Org org/kopman-build, served at none.

entries.title: Phase 5 — Video-to-quote AI, Marketplace, Cost Intelligence, White-label

Marketplace (multi-firm lead routing):

- Contact info released only after payment confirmed via webhook
- Lead TTL: 72h auto-expiry (pg_cron snippet in migration)
- Revenue tracking: leads sold, gross/net revenue per origin tenant

White-label (Enterprise):
- Custom domain, brand name, primary color, logo, favicon, custom CSS
- hideBuiltWith flag, supportEmail override

- Gated behind assertFeatureAccess("white_label") → Enterprise plan only

entries.title: scaffold Phase 1 — CRM, Project Hub, AI quote pipeline
entries.detail:
Build OS monorepo bootstrapped under /buildos:

  - Auto-provisions tenant from FlashyID org_id/buildos_tenant claim

- PostgreSQL schema via Drizzle ORM with Row-Level Security
  - All tenant-scoped tables enforce RLS via app.current_tenant_id session var
  - withTenant() helper sets the var per transaction
  - Separate migrator role (BYPASSRLS) vs app role (RLS enforced)
- tRPC v11 routers: leads, contacts, projects, ai

  - Lead pipeline aggregation, contact loyalty points, project financials
- AI photo-to-quote pipeline using Claude Vision (claude-opus-5)
  - Accepts 1–10 photos, returns structured line-item quote as draft
  - Haiku-backed caption generator for before/after media
- Dashboard KPI page (SSR server-side caller)
- Sidebar navigation with all 9 modules pre-wired
- Tailwind dark theme (gray-950 ground, teal-400 accent)

entries.title: Fix mobile drawer on all 691 pages: CSS injection and z-index
entries.detail:
Two bugs diagnosed from mobile screenshots:
1. 287 newly generated pages had drawer HTML but no mobile CSS (injection
   script couldn't match minified CSS string) — drawer items rendered
   inline, hamburger button was a grey square, accordion didn't work
2. All pages had mob-drawer z-index:200 equal to mega-menu dropdown,
   and homepage drawer was z-index:60 (below the sticky nav at z-index:50
   was barely above it) — drawer was obscured by the sticky nav bar

Fix: inject full mobile CSS into all pages missing it, bump mob-drawer
z-index to 300 site-wide, homepage drawer z-index 60→300. Add
display:block !important on .mob-group-body a to prevent cascade override.

entries.title: Fix dropdown positioning and hover-gap click bug on all pages
entries.detail:
Two bugs:
1. Homepage missing .nav-drop{position:relative} — dropdowns were anchoring
   to the header instead of their trigger, placing Markets and Resources at
   the far right of the page.
2. top:calc(100%+14px) created a 14px gap between trigger and dropdown;
   moving the mouse across the gap lost hover state, making items unclickable.
   Fixed with a .nav-drop::after pseudo-element that bridges the gap invisibly.

Applied to homepage + all 411 interior pages.
